title: Hardware Finding to Setup Branch Matcher
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Match six hardware probe findings to the setup branch each one triggers.

learningObjectives: The learner will apply the hardware-to-setup rules of this chapter to 6 findings by choosing the setup branch each finding triggers, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Findings 3 and 4 both list one GPU. Explain why they lead to different ways of sizing a model.
commonMisconceptions: Every DGX has dedicated GPU memory.
A download that completes will run on any DGX.
`nvidia-smi` always reports how much GPU memory there is.
A newer CUDA build is always better.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
